catalog_change_target.name: catalog_change_target
catalog_change_target.value: ("inventory_catalog_changes"."product_id" IS NOT NULL) <> ("inventory_catalog_changes"."location_id" IS NOT NULL)

clinical_note_pressure_valid.name: clinical_note_pressure_valid
clinical_note_pressure_valid.value: ("inventory_clinical_notes"."systolic_pressure" IS NULL OR "inventory_clinical_notes"."systolic_pressure" BETWEEN 40 AND 300) AND ("inventory_clinical_notes"."diastolic_pressure" IS NULL OR "inventory_clinical_notes"."diastolic_pressure" BETWEEN 20 AND 200)

clinical_note_vitals_valid.name: clinical_note_vitals_valid
clinical_note_vitals_valid.value: ("inventory_clinical_notes"."heart_rate" IS NULL OR "inventory_clinical_notes"."heart_rate" BETWEEN 20 AND 300) AND ("inventory_clinical_notes"."oxygen_saturation" IS NULL OR "inventory_clinical_notes"."oxygen_saturation" BETWEEN 50 AND 100) AND ("inventory_clinical_notes"."temperature_c" IS NULL OR "inventory_clinical_notes"."temperature_c" BETWEEN 30 AND 45) AND ("inventory_clinical_notes"."weight_kg" IS NULL OR "inventory_clinical_notes"."weight_kg">0 AND "inventory_clinical_notes"."weight_kg"<=500) AND ("inventory_clinical_notes"."height_cm" IS NULL OR "inventory_clinical_notes"."height_cm" BETWEEN 30 AND 250)

clinical_note_final_valid.name: clinical_note_final_valid
clinical_note_final_valid.value: ("inventory_clinical_notes"."status"='DRAFT' AND "inventory_clinical_notes"."finalized_at" IS NULL) OR ("inventory_clinical_notes"."status"='FINAL' AND "inventory_clinical_notes"."finalized_at" IS NOT NULL AND char_length(trim("inventory_clinical_notes"."evolution"))>=10)

encounter_prescription_final_valid.name: encounter_prescription_final_valid
encounter_prescription_final_valid.value: ("inventory_encounter_prescriptions"."status"='DRAFT' AND "inventory_encounter_prescriptions"."finalized_at" IS NULL) OR ("inventory_encounter_prescriptions"."status"='FINAL' AND "inventory_encounter_prescriptions"."finalized_at" IS NOT NULL AND jsonb_array_length("inventory_encounter_prescriptions"."items")>0)

encounter_quote_issued_valid.name: encounter_quote_issued_valid
encounter_quote_issued_valid.value: ("inventory_encounter_quotes"."status"='DRAFT' AND "inventory_encounter_quotes"."issued_at" IS NULL) OR ("inventory_encounter_quotes"."status"<>'DRAFT' AND "inventory_encounter_quotes"."issued_at" IS NOT NULL AND jsonb_array_length("inventory_encounter_quotes"."items")>0)

encounter_quote_lifecycle_valid.name: encounter_quote_lifecycle_valid
encounter_quote_lifecycle_valid.value: ("inventory_encounter_quotes"."status" IN ('DRAFT','ISSUED') AND "inventory_encounter_quotes"."approved_at" IS NULL AND "inventory_encounter_quotes"."declined_at" IS NULL AND "inventory_encounter_quotes"."paid_at" IS NULL) OR ("inventory_encounter_quotes"."status"='APPROVED' AND "inventory_encounter_quotes"."approved_at" IS NOT NULL AND "inventory_encounter_quotes"."declined_at" IS NULL AND "inventory_encounter_quotes"."paid_at" IS NULL) OR ("inventory_encounter_quotes"."status"='DECLINED' AND "inventory_encounter_quotes"."declined_at" IS NOT NULL AND "inventory_encounter_quotes"."approved_at" IS NULL AND "inventory_encounter_quotes"."paid_at" IS NULL) OR ("inventory_encounter_quotes"."status"='PAID' AND "inventory_encounter_quotes"."approved_at" IS NOT NULL AND "inventory_encounter_quotes"."declined_at" IS NULL AND "inventory_encounter_quotes"."paid_at" IS NOT NULL)

encounter_quote_payment_valid.name: encounter_quote_payment_valid
encounter_quote_payment_valid.value: ("inventory_encounter_quotes"."status"<>'PAID' AND "inventory_encounter_quotes"."payment_method" IS NULL AND "inventory_encounter_quotes"."payment_reference" IS NULL) OR ("inventory_encounter_quotes"."status"='PAID' AND "inventory_encounter_quotes"."payment_method" IS NOT NULL AND "inventory_encounter_quotes"."payment_method" IN ('PIX','CASH','CREDIT_CARD','DEBIT_CARD','BANK_TRANSFER','OTHER') AND char_length(coalesce("inventory_encounter_quotes"."payment_reference",''))<=500)

operation_type_valid.name: operation_type_valid
operation_type_valid.value: ("inventory_operations"."type" = 'TRANSFER' AND "inventory_operations"."destination_id" IS NOT NULL AND "inventory_operations"."destination_id" <> "inventory_operations"."source_id") OR ("inventory_operations"."type" = 'ADJUSTMENT' AND "inventory_operations"."destination_id" IS NULL)

clinical_problem_dates_valid.name: clinical_problem_dates_valid
clinical_problem_dates_valid.value: "inventory_patient_clinical_problems"."resolved_on" IS NULL OR "inventory_patient_clinical_problems"."onset_on" IS NULL OR "inventory_patient_clinical_problems"."resolved_on">="inventory_patient_clinical_problems"."onset_on"

patient_prescription_dates_valid.name: patient_prescription_dates_valid
patient_prescription_dates_valid.value: "inventory_patient_prescriptions"."issued_on" IS NULL OR ("inventory_patient_prescriptions"."valid_until" IS NOT NULL AND "inventory_patient_prescriptions"."valid_until" >= "inventory_patient_prescriptions"."issued_on")

patient_prescription_metadata_complete.name: patient_prescription_metadata_complete
patient_prescription_metadata_complete.value: ("inventory_patient_prescriptions"."prescriber_name" IS NULL AND "inventory_patient_prescriptions"."council_number" IS NULL AND "inventory_patient_prescriptions"."council_region" IS NULL AND "inventory_patient_prescriptions"."issued_on" IS NULL AND "inventory_patient_prescriptions"."valid_until" IS NULL) OR ("inventory_patient_prescriptions"."prescriber_name" IS NOT NULL AND char_length(trim("inventory_patient_prescriptions"."prescriber_name")) BETWEEN 2 AND 150 AND "inventory_patient_prescriptions"."council_number" IS NOT NULL AND char_length(trim("inventory_patient_prescriptions"."council_number")) BETWEEN 3 AND 30 AND "inventory_patient_prescriptions"."council_region" IS NOT NULL AND char_length(trim("inventory_patient_prescriptions"."council_region")) BETWEEN 2 AND 10 AND "inventory_patient_prescriptions"."issued_on" IS NOT NULL AND "inventory_patient_prescriptions"."valid_until" IS NOT NULL)

patient_document_valid.name: patient_document_valid
patient_document_valid.value: ("inventory_patients"."no_document" AND "inventory_patients"."document_type" IS NULL AND "inventory_patients"."document_number" IS NULL) OR (NOT "inventory_patients"."no_document" AND "inventory_patients"."document_type" IN ('CPF','PASSPORT') AND char_length(trim("inventory_patients"."document_number")) BETWEEN 5 AND 30) OR (NOT "inventory_patients"."no_document" AND "inventory_patients"."document_type" IS NULL AND "inventory_patients"."document_number" IS NULL)

patient_photo_metadata_valid.name: patient_photo_metadata_valid
patient_photo_metadata_valid.value: ("inventory_patients"."photo_blob_pathname" IS NULL AND "inventory_patients"."photo_filename" IS NULL AND "inventory_patients"."photo_content_type" IS NULL) OR ("inventory_patients"."photo_blob_pathname" IS NOT NULL AND char_length(trim("inventory_patients"."photo_filename")) BETWEEN 1 AND 180 AND "inventory_patients"."photo_content_type" IN ('image/jpeg','image/png','image/heic','image/heif'))

patient_consent_evidence_valid.name: patient_consent_evidence_valid
patient_consent_evidence_valid.value: ("inventory_patients"."consent_status" = 'PENDING' AND "inventory_patients"."consent_recorded_at" IS NULL AND "inventory_patients"."consent_recorded_by_user_id" IS NULL) OR ("inventory_patients"."consent_status" IN ('RECORDED','REVOKED') AND "inventory_patients"."consent_recorded_at" IS NOT NULL)

pricing_validation_requires_evidence.name: pricing_validation_requires_evidence
pricing_validation_requires_evidence.value: "inventory_pricing_presentations"."pricing_status" = 'DRAFT' OR ("inventory_pricing_presentations"."cost_source" IS NOT NULL AND length(trim("inventory_pricing_presentations"."cost_source")) >= 3 AND "inventory_pricing_presentations"."cost_valid_on" IS NOT NULL AND "inventory_pricing_presentations"."minimum_measurable_volume_ml" IS NOT NULL AND "inventory_pricing_presentations"."beyond_use_hours" IS NOT NULL AND "inventory_pricing_presentations"."assumptions_confirmed" AND "inventory_pricing_presentations"."validated_at" IS NOT NULL AND "inventory_pricing_presentations"."validated_by_actor" IS NOT NULL AND length(trim("inventory_pricing_presentations"."validated_by_actor")) >= 3)

inventory_user_professional_council_comp.name: inventory_user_professional_council_complete
inventory_user_professional_council_comp.value: ("inventory_users"."professional_council" IS NULL AND "inventory_users"."council_number" IS NULL AND "inventory_users"."council_region" IS NULL) OR (char_length(trim("inventory_users"."professional_council")) BETWEEN 2 AND 20 AND char_length(trim("inventory_users"."council_number")) BETWEEN 2 AND 30 AND "inventory_users"."council_region" ~ '^[A-Z]{2}$')
